title: Young Photographer
statementMd:
Among other things, Bob is keen on photography. Especially he likes to take pictures of sportsmen. That was the reason why he placed himself in position $*x*_{0}$ of a long straight racetrack and got ready to take pictures. But the problem was that not all the runners passed him. The total amount of sportsmen, training at that racetrack, equals $*n*$. And each of them regularly runs distances within a particular segment of the racetrack, which is the same for each sportsman. For example, the first sportsman runs from position $*a*_{1}$ to position $*b*_{1}$, the second — from $*a*_{2}$ to $*b*_{2}$

What is the minimum distance that Bob should move to have a chance to take pictures of each sportsman? Bob can take a picture of a sportsman, if he stands within the segment that this sportsman covers on the racetrack.

## Input

The first line of the input file contains integers $*n*$ and $*x*_{0}$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$; $0 ≤ *x*_{0} ≤ 1000$). The following $*n*$ lines contain pairs of integers $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$; $*a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$).

## Output

Output the required minimum distance in the same units as the positions on the racetrack. If there is no such a position, output -1.
statementZhMd:
鲍勃除了其他爱好之外，还热衷于摄影。他尤其喜欢给运动员拍照。正因如此，他站在一条笔直而漫长的赛道上的位置 $*x*_{0}$ 处，准备拍照。但问题是，并不是所有运动员都会经过他所在的位置。正在这条赛道上训练的运动员总数为 $*n*$。他们每个人都会在赛道的某个特定路段内定期跑步，并且这个路段对每位运动员来说都是固定的。例如，第一位运动员在位置 $*a*_{1}$ 到位置 $*b*_{1}$ 之间跑步，第二位运动员则在位置 $*a*_{2}$ 到位置 $*b*_{2}$ 之间跑步。

鲍勃至少需要移动多远，才能有机会给每位运动员拍照？如果鲍勃站在该运动员在赛道上跑过的路段内，他就可以给这位运动员拍照。

## 输入格式

输入文件的第一行包含整数 $*n*$ 和 $*x*_{0}$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$；$0 ≤ *x*_{0} ≤ 1000$）。接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含一对整数 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$；$*a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$）。

## 输出格式

输出所需的最小距离，距离单位与赛道上位置的单位相同。如果不存在这样的位置，输出 -1。
